subject: Fwd: Avicenna's current app testing
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Paul Mccrorie <Paul.McCrorie@glasgow.ac.uk>
Date: Fri, Sep 13, 2024 at 4:01 PM
Subject: Re: Avicenna's current app testing
To: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>, sara@avicennaresearch.com <sara@avicennaresearch.com>
Cc: Fiona Caryl <Fiona.Caryl@glasgow.ac.uk>


Hi Magda
 
Not had the easiest time setting up on my phone. Lot's of buggy error messages when trying to sign up, especially when entering the Study ID. It also said that an account for participant3 had already signed up (i haven't) so I've used participant10 instead. Within the instructions to setup on iPhone it needs me to validate the email address - is this for you to do Magda? It also needs me to turn on background app refresh in settings. When I go to settings it is on but greyed out and I can't change it. The app doesn't seem to recognise I have it switched on though.
 
Otherwise I'm not too sure if it has started recording my location data or not. Nothing to tell me it has.
 
Anything else I need to do?
 
Thanks,
 
Paul
From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Tuesday, September 10, 2024 11:32
To: Paul Mccrorie <Paul.McCrorie@glasgow.ac.uk>; sara@avicennaresearch.com <sara@avicennaresearch.com>
Subject: Avicenna's current app testing

Hi Paul, hi Fi

Hope you’re well. As promised here are the instructions of how to create participant and researcher account for the current Avicenna app.

If you have troubles with setting app your accounts please contact sara@avicennaresearch.com and CC me.

Once you’ve created your researcher account please let me know and I’ll add you to the platform.

All best

Magda

*****************************************************************************

To test your sample study from the participant's perspective, please follow the instructions below:

  1. Install the Avicenna mobile application on your smartphone. You can find the iOS app here and the Android app here.
  1. Launch the app and sign up as a new participant. Please note that you need to use the provided email address(es) as your username but you can choose your own password.
  1. When you are asked to enter the study registration code, enter the provided Study ID and follow the instructions. Check this document to learn more about this registration process.

- Study ID: 3950

- Participants’ usernames:

  • participant1@essex.ac.uk Magda
  • participant2@essex.ac.uk Giulia
  • participant3@essex.ac.uk Paul Mc
  • participant4@essex.ac.uk Annette
  • participant5@essex.ac.uk Jon
  • participant6@essex.ac.uk Jim
  • participant7@essex.ac.uk Sam
  • participant8@essex.ac.uk Owen
  • participant9@essex.ac.uk Fi C
  • participant10@essex.ac.uk

Moreover, if you and your team members would like to also try the researcher's side of our platform, you can create a researcher account here using the email addresses you shared with me earlier. Once done, please let me know so that I can add you as researchers to Study ID: 3950. As researchers, you will be able to access the sample study in your researcher dashboard.

Alternatively, if you prefer to join the study as participants using your organizational email addresses, please inform me so that I can invite the email addresses you shared before as participants.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
Amin Tavassolian Could you please let me know what you think about the above? Should we get back to them? Thanks.

Amin Tavassolian Other clients have reported the same issue with "Background App Refresh." I do not have access to an iOS device, but as far as I know, when the "Background App Refresh" option in the app settings is grayed out (disabled), it means that the Background App Refresh is disabled for the entire operating system. According to our onboarding guide, they should go to the Settings of their phone, then navigate to General > Background App Refresh, and enable the feature there to remove the banner. I have included an image. Please let me know if I can share this information with them. Thank you.

subject: Fwd: Avicenna's current app testing
body:
Hi Paul,

Thanks for sharing this. My name is Mohammad and I am the CEO of Avicenna.

I looked into the issues you reported and address one by one below.

Issue #1: Sign up problem
Our reports show the username "participant3@essex.ac.uk" was used on July 15th by Annette Jackle. I think that was a mistake on her end, because "participant4@essex.ac.uk" which was supposed to be used by her is still pending enrollment! Our reports show you tried to sign up once and failed, then tried to login which also failed, then tried to login 3 more times unsuccessfully. This is all expected considering the above error.

Issue #2: Enrollment in the study failed.
Our reports show you tried to enroll in the study at 12:20 UTC today, but it failed. On our end, we received an "HTTP 502" error. This happens when a service is disrupted. But we did not have any downtime around that time (https://status.avicennaresearch.com/). Another thing is that this is the only error of this kind we had reported today. So it is certainly an isolated incident. Even then, I asked my engineer to report why this happened!

Issue #3: Email verification
Avicenna can be configured to verify email and/or phone numbers or not. Study 3950 is configured to verify email. That's why you were prompted to do so. Given that these are dummy emails, I assume you could not finish this process successfully. As to why this is set this way, I am not in the loop.

Issue #4: iOS message for Background App Refresh
Let me reiterate the problem here:

   1. You received a notification to enable "Background App Refresh" (Image 1 and 2 attached)
   2. You Clicked and opened Settings, which said "Background App Refresh" is "On" (Image 3)
       - Here please note that even though the text is greyed out, you still can click on it and see options (Image 4) 
   3. You found "Avicenna" in the list (Image 5), tapped and went to the list and made sure "Background App Refresh" is "On" (Image 6).

If yes, I'm unsure why you still got a notification to enable this. My quick test on my phone showed the app behaves as expected (shows the warning when the option is disabled, hides it when its enabled). I have asked my iOS developer to check and give me a more detailed report by Monday though.

As a wrap up, I understand you had a bad experience due to both a series of unfortunate errors, and confusing UX that likely you did not write down. I'd love to set a call, and watch over your shoulder as you work with the app, write down any UX issues and make sure they are addressed. That can help me a lot to understand where are the shortcomings. Let me know if you have time for that.

Best,
Mohammad

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: product@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com
--
